text.en:
Section one of Act Numbered Thirty-four hundred and forty-three entitled "An Act to
appropriate the sum of fifty thousand pesos for the establishment, equipment, maintenance, and operation of
seed-farms for rice, corn, sugar cane and other staple crops under the Bureau of Agriculture, and for other
purposes," is hereby amended so as to read as follows:
"Section 1. There is hereby appropriated out of the funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated,
the sum of fifty thousand pesos to be used in the establishment, maintenance, equipment, and operation of
seed-farms and experiment stations for the purpose of raising selected and pedigreed seeds-rice, corn, sugar
cane, coffee, coconut and other staple crops-for distribution to the farmers throughout the Philippine Islands,
in accordance with the provisions of this Act."

Section four of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 4. Subject to the general executive control and:, supervision of the Secretary of Agriculture and
Natural Resources, the Director of Agriculture shall have the expenditures as he may deem necessary for the
proper carrying out of the purposes of this Act: Provided, however, That no person appointed under this Act
shall receive as compensation more than three thousand and six hundred pesos annually.

It shall be the duty of the Director of Commerce and Industry to submit annually to the
Philippine Legislature through proper channels, an estimate of expenditures necessary to carry out the work
specified by this Act; and the inclusion of such estimate of expenditures in the proposed budget for every year
is hereby authorized.

This Act shall take effect on January first, nineteen hundred and thirty.
Approved, December 5, 1929.
